name: Collecting Kelp
summary: In Goldshire, Maybell Maclure seeks to visit Tommy Joe Stonefield unseen. William Pestle needs rare crystal kelp to brew her an invisibility liquor.

sections.title: A Remedy for Forbidden Love
sections.body: The feud between the Stonefield and Maclure families keeps Maybell Maclure and Tommy Joe Stonefield from meeting openly. Maybell wants to see the one she loves without bringing their kin into an armed clash. So she seeks a way to cross the valley unseen. William Pestle, an herbalist and apothecary at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, plans to brew an invisibility liquor, but its rare ingredients are not in the inn's cupboards.

sections.title: The Scavengers of Crystal Lake
sections.body: William Pestle needs crystal kelp as the catalyst for his brew. Its fronds usually grow far out in saltwater oceans, but tribal murlocs have carried stashes inland to their crude camps along Crystal Lake, just east of Goldshire. Their peculiar instincts draw them to haul the marine plants to the freshwater shore. You need to recover enough fronds from the murlocs before returning to Goldshire with them.

faq.q: Why does William Pestle need crystal kelp?
faq.answer: William Pestle needs crystal kelp to brew an invisibility liquor for Maybell Maclure. The drink is meant to help her leave her family's vineyard unseen and visit Tommy Joe Stonefield.

faq.q: Why is ocean kelp found near freshwater Crystal Lake?
aliases: why is kelp at crystal lake
faq.answer: Crystal kelp grows in the ocean, but tribal murlocs around Crystal Lake scavenge the fronds and carry them inland. They hoard the kelp in lakeside camps, the only local source near Goldshire.

faq.q: Who are Maybell Maclure and Tommy Joe Stonefield?
faq.answer: Maybell Maclure and Tommy Joe Stonefield are young lovers from rival farming families in southern Elwynn Forest. Their families despise each other, so the pair rely on secrecy and alchemical tricks to meet.
Crystal Lake lies just east of Goldshire in central Elwynn Forest. Hostile murlocs infest its waters and shores.

faq.q: What happens after collecting the kelp?
faq.answer: After you deliver four crystal kelp fronds, William Pestle distills them into an Invisibility Liquor. Then he asks you to bring it to Maybell Maclure so she can slip away unseen.
William Pestle is an apothecary and alchemical dabbler at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. He helps locals with folk remedies, strange potions, and confidential favors.

angles.text: For you as a gatherer, crystal kelp is an odd find: an ocean herb taken from the pouches of freshwater murlocs, not from soil or seabed.
For the Alliance, clearing the murloc camps around Crystal Lake for Pestle helps quiet the aggressive menace near Goldshire's eastern road.
